title: How I Audit for ROI — Find the Leaks, Size the Cost, Fix What Pays

sections.label: 1 · MAP THE REVENUE PATH
sections.note: Before touching anything, I map where every lead enters and what it should be worth by the time it converts.

sections.label: 2 · FIND WHERE MONEY LEAKS
sections.note: Every drop-off, stall, or wasted send is either lost revenue or wasted spend.

sections.label: 3 · SIZE THE COST
sections.note: Every leak gets a real dollar number, not a general note that something looks off.

sections.label: 4 · FIX FOR ROI
sections.note: I fix the highest-dollar leak first and prove the fix worked in the numbers, not just in what changed.

nodes.label: List Every Funnel and Automation Currently Spending Money or Time
Map Where Each Lead Enters and What It Should Be Worth
Trace Exactly Where Leads Drop Off or Stall
Flag Steps Burning Ad Spend or Tool Cost With No Return
Put a Dollar Number on Every Leak: Lost Leads x Close Rate x Deal Value
Rank Every Leak by Revenue Impact, Highest Cost First
Fix the Highest-ROI Leak First, Not the Easiest One
Adjust the Funnel to Close Where the Money Was Leaking
Re-Measure Conversion Rate and Cost Per Lead After the Fix
Report the Dollar Impact, Not Just What Changed

output_sample.highest_leak_monthly_cost: $24,138 in lost revenue from unanswered leads going cold after 24 hours
output_sample.fix_applied: Added a no-response branch with a second touch at 24h and 72h
